scripts.//: Libraries resolve to source during dev (see tsconfig paths), so the app build compiles them and `ng serve` needs no lib build. build:libs produces real ng-packagr packages — run it only to publish or to consume a library from another repo. Order matters: core, then ui, then the features that depend on both.
scripts.build:libs: ng build @trackly/core && ng build @trackly/ui && ng build @trackly/auth && ng build @trackly/dashboard && ng build @trackly/tickets && ng build @trackly/admin && ng build @trackly/portal && ng build @trackly/guest
